Name: The Farm
Description: The Farmer's home and the main center of action. The farmhouse is initially dilapidated and the farm overgrown. The farmhouse can be upgraded to add a kitchen and other rooms including a room for the player's spouse to use after marriage. The house is initially single story, though one of the later upgrades adds a cellar. Other farm buildings include: Barn, Coop, Greenhouse, Silo, Stable, Shed, and Fish Pond.

Name: Pelican Town
Description: The main town area where most villagers live and work. Contains Pierre's General Store, JojaMart, the Stardrop Saloon, Harvey's Clinic, the Blacksmith, the Library & Museum, and the Community Center.

Name: Pierre's General Store
Description: Sells seeds, saplings, and vegetables. Owned by Pierre who lives there with his wife Caroline and their daughter Abigail, all of whom regard it as a shared family business. Pierre has a stall at most special events and festivals.

Name: JojaMart
Description: Offers a similar range of goods as Pierre's but at slightly different prices. Recently opened in Pelican Town and employs anti-competitive practices towards local businesses. Offers a membership program which the player can join. Shane works here.

Name: Stardrop Saloon
Description: A social hub where villagers gather. Offers food, drinks, pool, and arcade games. Owned by Gus. Food options rotate, but the standard offerings are pizza, salad, spaghetti, bread, coffee and beer.

Name: Harvey's Clinic
Description: Open during weekdays for health-related services and selling health items. Maru works here part-time.

Name: Blacksmith
Description: Owned by Clint. Allows the Farmer to upgrade tools, process geodes, or buy ores and coal.

Name: Library & Museum
Description: Donated artifacts and minerals are displayed here. Run by Gunther, who rewards players for donations.

Name: Community Center
Description: Formerly the social heart of Pelican Town. When the Farmer arrives it is dilapidated but unless the player chooses to buy a Jojamart membership can be restored later in the game. If the player does buy a Jojamart membership it is converted into a Joja Warehouse.

Name: Cindersap Forest
Description: Contains Leah's Cottage, Marnie's Ranch and the Wizard's Tower. It is visited on Fridays and Sundays by a traveling cart which sells rare items.

Name: Marnie's Ranch
Description: Sells animals and animal supplies. Marnie lives here with her pre-teen granddaughter Jas and her nephew Shane.

Name: Wizard's Tower
Description: Home to the Wizard. Is regarded with great suspicion by the other villagers. Center of many magical activities in the game.

Name: Mountain
Description: North of Pelican Town, contains the Carpenter's Shop, the Tent where Linus lives, the Mines and the Adventurer's Guild.

Name: Adventurer's Guild
Description: Favored hang-out of mine explorers and other adventurers in Pelican Town. Not visited and rarely mentioned by other villagers other than Abigail and Sebastian who hold it in awe.
UnlockCondition: Reach mine level 120 or kill 10 slimes

Name: The Mines
Description: Generally regarded as spooky and dangerous by the townsfolk. Villagers other than the Farmer, Clint, Abigail, Linus and Sebastian are too afraid to ever enter them. Full of monsters, ore, gems and other collectible items. Contains 120 levels.

Name: Spa
Description: Contains a swimming pool and gym. The gym is popular for sports training and the pool restores energy and health.

Name: Train Station
Description: North of the mountain, next to the Spa. Occasionally, trains pass through, often dropping items.

Name: Quarry
Description: Not accessible in the first year or so of the game. Just past the adventurers guild. Contains various rocks and ores to mine.

Name: Beach
Description: The beach area south of Pelican Town. Contains Willy's Fish Shop, the tide pools, and the dock. Once the ferry to Ginger Island is repaired it leaves from here.

Name: Fish Shop
Description: Run by and home to Willy, sells fishing supplies and fish-related items as well as buying fish. Once the ferry to Ginger Island is repaired it leaves from here.

Name: Tide Pools
Description: A series of rock pools that can be made accessible by a bridge on the beach. A great place for foraging coral and sea urchins as well as shells from the beach.

Name: Desert
Description: Not accessible until the Bus is repaired - typically late in year 1. Contains the Oasis as well as the Skull Cavern and regular markets and merchants.
UnlockCondition: Repair bus (500g via Joja or Community Center bundles)

Name: Oasis
Description: A shop run by Sandy, who also lives there. The shop sells unique seeds and items such as cactus, starfruit and beet seeds.

Name: Skull Cavern
Description: A more dangerous mine that is inaccessible until the town mine is completed and the bus repaired. Most town residents have no knowledge of this mine. Has no bottom level.
UnlockCondition: Repair bus and reach mine level 120

Name: Ginger Island
Description: An island off the coast of Pelican Town which is popular as a day trip destination for the villagers. Contains a resort, a farm and many tropical birds and animals. The island has a year round tropical climate and the contrast of this to Stardew Valley makes it a risk for sunburn and heatstroke for the villagers. Tends to be busy, particularly on the beach.
UnlockCondition: Repair Willy's boat (200 hardwood, 5 battery packs, 5 iridium bars)

Name: Sewers
Description: Underground area accessible after obtaining the Rusty Key. Home to Krobus who sells rare items.

Name: Pam's Trailer
Description: A small trailer where Pam and Penny live. Can be upgraded later in the game.
